verdict.rationale: Penpot ships self-hostable Docker Compose/Kubernetes/Helm deployments and a first-party MCP server that a probe confirmed runs fully headless (keyless JSON-RPC handshake, no UI) plus webhooks and access-token API auth, all of which support automation-oriented, non-interactive operation. However, there is no documented CLI, test-runner mode, or explicit CI/CD pipeline integration for the core Penpot app itself (only its MCP companion service). Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI/headless mode for the design app, explicit CI pipeline examples, and independent confirmation of automation stability at scale.
